claim: Two startup defects on the human-capper activation path are repaired: the worker can start in bounded human-capper mode, and Command Center can start from its canonical deploy-written env file with no manual host patch. Nothing about inertness changes -- the target is still killed, still registry-disabled, and the delivery posture flag is still false.
note: Increment 3. Measured against the RUNNING production system and against an image built at this head. The canonical deploy was not dispatched; that is reserved to Griff, and Human Capper activation stays OFF until this merges and is separately deployed.

defect_repaired.symptom: worker container in Restarting (1); RuntimeConfigError RUNTIME_REQUIRED_ENV_MISSING at apps/worker/src/runtime.ts:284
defect_repaired.mechanism: deploy.yml:612/1411 refuse UNIT_TALK_DISCORD_TARGET_MAP containing discord:official-picks; assertDiscordTargetMapCoversTargets refused its absence. No value of the secret satisfied both.
defect_repaired.why_the_assertion_was_wrong: delivery-adapters.ts WORKER_PINNED_DESTINATION_GUARD resolves a human delivery target from the per-capper pin on the outbox row and refuses rather than falling back to the shared map, so the assertion demanded a mapping the delivery path never reads.
defect_repaired.fix: exempt human delivery targets via the canonical isHumanDeliveryTarget predicate; the deploy-time refusal is unchanged.
defect_repaired.escape_hatch_note: parked mode starts only because its target discord:1296531122234327100 matches ^discord:\d+$; discord:official-picks has no such form.

defect_repaired.symptom: Command Center unreachable in production; served only via a hand-patched /opt/unit-talk/.env.command-center that the next deploy erases
defect_repaired.mechanism: loadEnvironment required five workspace-metadata names with zero runtime readers, and requireSupabaseEnvironment required SUPABASE_ANON_KEY even for a service-role caller that discards it. The deploy-written file carries none of the six, so startup failed one variable at a time.
defect_repaired.fix: workspace metadata is optional in the runtime loader (requireEnv deleted -- those five were its only callers); the Supabase credential check is role-aware. deploy.yml is unchanged: its ten keys were already correct.
defect_repaired.not_done: the six values were NOT added to deploy.yml; that would institutionalize fake dependencies and ship an unused credential
